message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on document cases. These are articles of a kind normally carried in pocket or handbag, or briefcase-type containers. Heading 4202 covers trunks, suitcases, briefcases, school satchels, and similar containers. Document cases are like briefcases, so subheading 4202.11 (outer surface of leather) or 4202.12 (outer surface of plastic sheeting or textile materials).

Since the articles come with either outer surface, classification splits by material: leather would be 4202.11.00, and plastic would be 4202.12.

Statistical suffixes: 4202.11.00 has 4202.11.0030 (briefcases) and 4202.11.0090 (other). 4202.12.21 covers briefcases, with the outer surface of plastic sheeting: 4202.12.2000? In reality, 4202.12.20 is "With outer surface of sheeting of plastics," with 4202.12.2020 for briefcases, school bags, etc. I believe 4202.12.21 is "Backpacks"... Not sure. I'll select the plastic option: 4202.12.2050 ("Other"?). The document case is a briefcase-like item, so the best guess is 4202.12.2000-series... Alternatively, leather 4202.11.0090 for "Other".

I'll choose the leather one, 4202.11.0090.
